The fingers on the fretboard are poorly defined and appear to merge with the neck of the guitar. The anatomy of the hand is ambiguous, with unclear finger separation and joint positioning.
The microphone pole seems to vanish or blend into the background lighting without a clear connection to a base or stand structure, creating a slight floating effect.
